static_traits.name: Chen Hao
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with band members and friends are strained by a persistent negative mindset; has supportive roommates and bandmates, but has not yet fully expressed feelings and troubles to them
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not yet received treatment or counseling for other psychological issues; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly cooperative; recurring negative predictions and expressions of despair; can consider taking small steps for reality testing under guidance

basic_info.main_problem: After my flight ticket was cancelled, I feel despair about whether I can still go to Britain, which leaves me in extreme pain and disappointment.
basic_info.core_demands: Overwhelmed by despair and disappointment about the travel plans, I need help coping with and regulating these feelings.

core_beliefs: Good things won't happen to me
I am unable to control fate; the outside world is against me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If an important plan is interrupted, it means it will never happen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids rebooking and further action to avoid being disappointed again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I'll never get to Britain in this lifetime

special_situations.event: Sees photos of others traveling to the UK or hears others talk about UK trips
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others can do it but I can't right now, it means I never will
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding Britain-related information or topics, reduced socializing to avoid being triggered
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone else can go; only I can't

special_situations.event: Starting to consider or prepare to check/rebook tickets
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I try again, I will definitely fail again, and I will suffer more than now
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating, stopping information searches to reduce short-term anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The affirmation will be canceled again; something always goes wrong

special_situations.event: Thinking about being unable to go to Britain during rehearsals or performances
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one important goal falls through, other things will also go wrong accordingly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing effort, mind elsewhere, behavioral avoidance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nothing I do will go smoothly

core_conflict.wish: Longs to realize a travel dream cherished for many years and to gain satisfaction and a sense of control
core_conflict.fear: Fearing that hoping again will end in shattered hopes, sinking into deeper loss of control and despair
defense_goal: Lowering disappointment and anxiety through pessimistic predictions and avoidance

object_relations.object_representation: Uncontrollable outside world/fate working against oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Used when the counselor suggests taking small steps (such as checking flights or contacting the airline) or encourages them to re-evaluate feasibility
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Hoping or taking action will only lead to being defeated by reality again (experiencing the counselor's encouragement as unrealistic, anticipating being hurt again)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone is cautious and hesitant, emphasizing the worst possibilities; repeatedly expressing 'don't get your hopes up too much', tactfully postponing immediate action.

manifestations: After a dream trip planned for years is canceled, feels 'the universe is against me'
Losing drive and meaning in daily life, sinking into hopelessness
Seeing others travel triggers intense reactions, experiencing frustrated self-worth and expectations

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward others or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning inward instead (redirecting energy from outward to inward).
manifestations: Avoiding contacting the airline or looking up options to avoid further frustration
Not expressing the true extent of pain to roommates and bandmates
Pushes back the impulse to seek support and act outwardly, maintaining stagnation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Repeated self-restriction: daring not to 'hope again' to avoid being hurt again
When discussing actions, emphasizes risks and worst outcomes, cautiously lowering expectations

positive_force: Having supportive roommates and band partners who can provide emotional support
Long-term planning and strong motivation for the UK trip, showing sustained commitment ability
Has some willingness for reality testing (can consider alternatives and small steps)
Physically healthy, without serious medical burden, with professional and team role responsibilities
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking patterns reinforcing hopelessness
Strong sense of external control; tends to believe 'the universe is against me'
Avoiding action and procrastinating (not looking up information, not rebooking tickets), relieving pressure short-term but maintaining the problem
Ruminative negative thinking disrupts attention and causes low mood
Not fully expressing needs and emotions to the support network, reducing chances of gaining external resources

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding rebooking tickets and gathering information
antecedent: When preparing to take action (checking flights / contacting the airline)
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of disappointment and loss of control again; catastrophic predictions about the future suppress action
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and disappointment, reducing anxiety and pain short-term
target_behavior.consequence: Travel goals stagnate, negative emotions persist; work and interpersonal relations are harmed, daily routine is disrupted

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated negative ruminative thoughts ('I'll never get to Britain')
antecedent: Sees photos of others' trips to the UK or hears related stories
When being alone or recalling the cancellation
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by external locus of control and black-and-white beliefs; craving certainty and a self-protective low-expectation strategy
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain certainty through constant rumination, while lowering expectations to reduce the risk of being hurt again
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood, poor concentration, declining performance; relationship tension with friends/bandmates
